judge.reason: The answer follows Shostack's four questions with a mermaid diagram and trust boundaries B1–B4. It covers shell-as-confused-deputy (T3), lingering password clips with exclusion hints and auto-clear (T1), and background snooping via clipboard managers and accessibility bypass, each with a mitigation. It never raises focus spoofing or focus-steal, where a malicious app grabs keyboard focus to receive a paste, which is one of the threats the rubric requires.
